svg.aria-label: Carolina ID card with a Tomb Raider inspired jungle background
svg.text: “A famous explorer once said, that the
extraordinary is in what we do, not who we
are. I’d finally set out to make my mark; to
find adventure. But instead adventure found
me. In our darkest moments, when life flashes
before us, we find something; Something that
keeps us going. Something that pushes us.”
